auth_realm.description: Authentication realm name (if using RFC 2229 AUTH). Leave empty to disable.

bind_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the server to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

bind_port.description: Port number to listen on. RFC 2229 reserves port 2628 for DICOD.

client_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) before disconnecting a client connection.

compression.description: Enable gzip compression for large response bodies (supported by RFC 2229 clients).

databases.description: List of database definitions with per-database settings. Each entry defines a dictionary source.

allow_hosts.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR networks. If empty, all hosts are allowed by default.

deny_hosts.description: List of denied IP addresses or CIDR networks. Takes precedence over allow_hosts.

description.description: Human-readable description of this dictionary (shown in INFO DB command).

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return per query for this database. Omit or null for no limit.

name.description: Identifier for the database (must match the base filename in dict_dir).

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the dictionary file (relative to dict_dir if not absolute).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output (logs extra diagnostics).

default_db.description: List of dictionary database names to use by default when no DB is specified in a client query.

dict_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing dictionary database files.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.
